bonus.q: Hvad betyder 2NT, når makker har doblet deres svage 2?
bonus.correct: Relæ – svag hånd med en farve lavere end deres
options: Relæ – svag hånd med en farve lavere end deres
bonus.why: 2NT er relæ: dobler melder 3♣, og svarer passer eller retter til sin farve. Samme farve meldt direkte på 3-trinnet viser invit.

bonus.q: What does 2NT mean when partner has doubled their weak two?
bonus.correct: Relay – a weak hand with a suit lower than theirs
options: Relay – a weak hand with a suit lower than theirs
bonus.why: 2NT is a relay: the doubler bids 3♣, and the advancer passes or corrects to the suit. The same suit bid directly at the three level is invitational.
